[center][font=Courier New][color=#c27ba0][size=6][b]~ABOUT~[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Courier New]
[color=#d5a6bd][b]Goldi's Gilmore Girls Clothing for Fashion Sense[/b] currently adds three new shirts and three new pants/skirts inspired by Gilmore Girls to Stardew Valley using Fashion Sense and with GH's Peach Body Type in mind! I've always admired the cozy autumn aesthetic of the show, and I wanted my farmer to match that!
Currently,[b] Goldi's Gilmore Girls Clothing for Fashion Sense [/b]adds the following clothing items to the Fashion Sense mirror:
[u][b]Shirts:[/b] Rory's Navy Crewneck, Rory's Red Turtleneck, Rory's White Sweater[/u][/color][/font]
[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New][u][b]Pants:[/b] Rory's Checkered Skirt, Rory's Grey Skirt, Rory's Jeans[/u][/font][/color]

[font=Courier New][u][color=#d5a6bd][b]Future Plans:[/b] adding additional animation frames for Rory's Jeans, adding more shoes, hats, accessories, Lorelai's outfits[/color][/u][/font]
[line]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Courier New][color=#c27ba0][size=6][b]~INSTALLATION~[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Courier New]
[color=#d5a6bd][b] Goldi's Gilmore Girls Clothing for Fashion Sense [/b]can be installed or uninstalled at any time during your playthrough!
1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]downloaded and have run it to install. Directions on how to do so can be found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]here[/url]!
2. Download, unzip, and drag [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] into your Stardew Valley mods folder OR download using a mod manager.[/color][/font]
[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New]3. Download, unzip, and drag [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=files]Fashion Sense[/url] into your Stardew Valley mods folder OR download using a mod manager.[/font][/color]
[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New]4. It is HIGHLY recommended (but not mandatory) that you download [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] or another similar body mod. If you don't, the mod will still work, but the clothing may look strange at times.
5. Download this mod's file, unzip it, and drag it into your mods folder OR download using a mod manager.
6. Enjoy![/font][/color]

[line]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Courier New][color=#c27ba0][size=6][b]~COMPATIBILITY~[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Courier New]
[color=#d5a6bd][b] Goldi's Gilmore Girls Clothing for Fashion Sense [/b]is compatible with any and all mods. However, some of the clothing may look wonky if you're not using [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] (specifically the non-tall version) or a similar body mod. [/color][/font]

[line]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Courier New][color=#c27ba0][size=6][b]~FAQ~[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Courier New]
[color=#d5a6bd][b]Q: Will you include compatibility with the vanilla body/other body mods?
[/b]A: If there is enough demand for it, I may consider.

[b]Q: How do I use the clothing?
[/b]A: Use the Fashion Sense mirror to select the clothes from this mod![/color][/font]

[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New][b]Q: Why can't I change the color of the clothing?
[/b]A: I did this intentionally so that the outfits closely match some of those seen on Gilmore Girls. If people want me to make a version that allows for color changing, I'll consider.

[b]Q: Help! My farmer has no sleeves!
[/b]A: Please configure your body mod to toggle sleeves on. BOOM! Sleeves![/font][/color]

[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New][b]Q: The pants look strange when I sit/during certain animations...?
[/b]A: I'm working on adding frames for the new clothing for all necessary animations, but there's like probably 60 lol. It'll take a little while for this mod to cover all bases.[/font][/color]

[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New][b]Q: Your mod wrecked my farmer's body! They're purple and growing tendrils!
[/b]A: Sorry to hear. All my mod does is add clothing for use with Fashion Sense and provides sleeve compatibility if your body mod supports that. Feel free to let me know about your issue, but it's probably not my mod causing it.[/font][/color]

[color=#d5a6bd][font=Courier New][b]Q: What other mods are used in your screenshots?
[/b]A: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19125?tab=files]Churpy's Vivid Hairstyles[/url] for the hair and [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url] for the body/skin/eyes/shoes/sleeves!

Please feel free to leave other questions in the comments section![/font][/color]
